title: Climate-Related Disasters
description: DSC 106 Project 2: A team report presenting opposing arguments about climate-related disaster frequency. It examines aggregation, time windows, and chart framing, with a discussion of ethical tradeoffs.
tools: Data source: IMF Climate Change Indicators Dashboard.

title: Food Processing Across Grocery Categories
description: DSC 106 Project 1: A static visualization comparing GroceryDB processing-score distributions across food categories, including bread and ice cream/desserts, with a discussion of the design choices.
tools: Methods and tools: Python, pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.

title: CLEAR
description: An educational mobile prototype exploring experimental skin-lesion image classification. It connects an Expo app to a FastAPI service and includes image upload validation and model evaluation.
tools: Technologies: Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, TypeScript, React Native, and Expo.

title: Reading Motion in the Wild
description: A report exploring activity recognition from phone and smartwatch sensor data in UCSD's ExtraSensory dataset. It covers missing data, compares classification models, and presents interactive visualizations.
tools: Methods and tools: logistic regression, ExtraTrees, scikit-learn, and Plotly.

title: GDP Nowcasting for the Turkish Economy
description: A Stata analysis that combines electricity consumption, bank credit, and card spending into a weekly economic index, then relates that index to quarterly Turkish GDP.
tools: Methods and tools: Stata, principal component analysis, and ordinary least squares regression.
